text:
Nina Rao: Flagging oddity from CI: artifact ae3f9b-credentials.tar.gz pushed to public-registry with files encrypted via vault-transit. Looks like wrapping key 'transit-wrap-prod-1' was used. Not plaintext but external IPs fetched it.
Tom Becker: Can you paste the artifact path and any headers? Who pushed it?
Nina Rao: Path: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/public/ae3f9b-credentials.tar.gz. Pushed by ci-runner@redwood-ci. Artifact metadata: Vault-Transit-Key: transit-wrap-prod-1, x-ci-runner=runner-13, created: 2026-03-23T09:12Z.
Lina Ortiz: If an external party fetched the artifact and Unwrap was called, this looks serious. Check Vault audit logs for transit/unwrap for that key.
secbot: Alert: Vault audit shows token 04ab... used transit.unwrap on key 'transit-wrap-prod-1' from IP 198.51.100.47 at 2026-03-23T09:14:03Z. Token principal: ci-runner@redwood-ci.
Tom Becker: That IP belongs to public scanner list (scansrc-01). Could be benign but must assume compromise until proven otherwise. Step 1: block public access to that artifact, revoke the runner token, and rotate transit key.
Nina Rao: Blocking artifact now: `gcloud artifacts repositories delete --quiet public-registry/ae3f9b-credentials` (done). Token revoke command queued.
infra-bot: CI token revocation job queued: job-90021.
Harper Lee: Note: Some services use that transit key to wrap DB creds for internal backups. We need rewrap flow + credential rotation. I'll gather list of Vault secrets that reference transit-wrap-prod-1.
Kyle Mendoza: I'll start an audit query: `vault audit read --filter='transit-wrap-prod-1' --since='2026-03-22T00:00Z'` and `gcloud logging read 'jsonPayload.keyName:transit-wrap-prod-1'`.
Lina Ortiz: RBAC: remove CI runner service account's ability to create new artifacts until we confirm pipeline hardening. Open an IAM change with emergency tag.
Tom Becker: Also check if sealed-secrets controller is using the same transit key or a different one. If the controller unwraps via that key, k8s secrets could be at risk.
Nina Rao: Sealed-secrets controller uses k8s-sealed-key-2024, different. Good catch though. Backups used transit-wrap-prod-1.
secbot: Audit hint: 3 unwraps from token 04ab... within 2 minutes. Recommended: revoke token, rotate transit key, and rewrap existing ciphertexts.
Harper Lee: Proposed plan: 1) emergency revoke of CI token and block artifact URL, 2) provision new transit key 'transit-wrap-prod-2' (HSM), 3) rewrap ciphertexts in backups and artifact store to new key, 4) rotate underlying DB creds, 5) update Secret Manager / Vault wrapped ciphertexts, 6) run smoke tests, 7) hold old key for 24h.
Kyle Mendoza: Rewrap approach note: Do not decrypt to disk. Use Vault transit rewrap API or an ephemeral host that streams plaintext to re-encrypt. Example: `vault write -f transit/rewrap/transit-wrap-prod-2 ciphertext=@old.ct` (pseudo).
Tom Becker: If Vault supports rewrap, prefer server-side rewrap to avoid plaintext exposure. Check Vault version and transit plugin capabilities.
Nina Rao: Vault version is 1.13. Server-side rewrap endpoint exists: `POST /v1/transit/rewrap/transit-wrap-prod-2`. I'll validate in staging first.
Lina Ortiz: RBAC PR: I'll remove `create` on artifacts for `redwood-ci` SA and add a conditional that prevents publishing credentials artifacts to public repo. Tagging @oncall-security for emergency approval.
Tom Becker: Also rotate any KMS keys that are used to wrap backups which reference this transit key (cross-system dependencies). Create dependency map.
secbot: Dependency scan: Found 7 backup jobs (backup-db-*, backup-cache-*) referencing transit-wrap-prod-1.
Harper Lee: I'll take ownership of rewrap for backup artifacts. Nina, Kyle - can you help run rewrap canary against backup-db-01?
Nina Rao: I can run canary on backup-db-01. Will use ephemeral host and stream through Vault APIs.
Kyle Mendoza: Throttle parallelism to avoid rate limits. Running audit queries in parallel to ensure no other unknown tokens used the key.
Lina Ortiz: Timeline request: canary now, full rewrap within 4 hours, credential rotation for DB creds within 2 hours after canary success. We need incident ticket for SLAs and vendor contact.
Tom Becker: Creating INCIDENT-1796023456 now. Link in ticket to artifact dump and audit logs.
infra-bot: INCIDENT-1796023456 created and assigned to eng-security.
Harper Lee: Post-containment checklist: revoke tokens, rewrap artifacts, rotate DB passwords, update Vault secret paths, run end-to-end tests, monitor for failed unwrap attempts, schedule key destroy after 7 days if no further activity.
Nina Rao: Canary rewrap complete on backup-db-01. Steps: used ephemeral host, called `/v1/transit/rewrap/transit-wrap-prod-2` with old ciphertext, verified new ciphertext decrypts and DB creds valid. No plaintext persisted.
Kyle Mendoza: Audit check after canary: no new unwraps from external IPs. Good sign.
Tom Becker: Approve full rewrap. Lina, merge RBAC PR and enforce conditional on artifact publishing.
Lina Ortiz: PR merged and applied. Policy now denies publishing artifacts with MIME type 'application/x-credentials' to public repo.
secbot: Config change logged.
Harper Lee: Full rewrap started. Throttling at 12 concurrent streams. Monitoring for rate limits.
Nina Rao: I'll start credential rotations for DB users after rewrap completes on each backup cluster. Coordinate with app teams for short deploy window.
Kyle Mendoza: Running integration smoke tests as backups are rewrapped. Reporting 2 transient failures (timeouts), will retry.
Tom Becker: After rewrap and rotation, we should snapshot audit logs, hold old key for 48h (not destroy immediately), and prepare vendor postmortem request. Add remediation item: rotate CI runner credentials and add pipeline artifact validation.
Harper Lee: Noted. Also adding follow-ups: 1) enable more restrictive Vault audit forwarding to SIEM, 2) rotate any long-lived tokens used by pipeline, 3) run secret-sleuth scans for artifacts older than 30 days.
Nina Rao: Status update: rewrap 5/7 backup jobs complete, DB credential rotation started for the first cluster. ETA full containment ~5h.
secbot: Vulnerability triage: mark exposure severity: high. Auto-create postmortem stub when incident closes.
Tom Becker: Thanks all. Keep any external comms through Security and Legal. We'll meet for a 15m sync in 30m to review timeline and handoffs.
